description: This file contains function prototypes, macro definitions, and constants for managing power features on STM32F10x microcontrollers, including power level detection, regulator states, stop mode entry, and flag handling.

methods.name: PWR_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the power control registers to their default reset state.

methods.name: PWR_BackupAccessCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables access to the backup domain.

methods.name: PWR_PVDCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the Programmable Voltage Detector.

methods.name: PWR_WakeUpPinCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the WakeUp pin.

methods.name: PWR_EnterSTOPMode
methods.description: Enters STOP mode with specified regulator state and entry method.

methods.name: PWR_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of specified power flags.
